zh: 我昨晚睡得很差。
en: I slept {badly|poorly|terribly} last night.

zh: 每日随餐服用一片。
en: Take one tablet {daily|a day|every day|each day} with food.

zh: 你应该定期看牙医，而不是等到疼了才去。
en: You should see a dentist {regularly}, not just when something hurts.

zh: 医生把我的膝盖彻底检查了一遍。
en: The doctor examined my knee {thoroughly|carefully}.

zh: 我今天感觉好多了，谢谢。
en: I'm feeling {much|a lot|far|way} better today, thanks.

zh: 我突然觉得头晕，只好坐下来。
en: I {suddenly} felt dizzy and had to sit down.

zh: 只是感冒而已，不严重。
en: It's {only|just} a cold, nothing serious.

zh: 我最近总觉得很累。
en: I've been feeling tired {lately|recently}.

zh: 听说最近有一种很厉害的流感在传播。
en: {Apparently}, there's a nasty flu going around.

zh: 用鼻子慢慢吸气。
en: Breathe in {slowly} through your nose.

zh: 疼痛已经完全消失了。
en: The pain has {completely|totally|entirely} gone.

zh: 他在一场车祸中受了重伤。
en: He was {seriously|badly|severely} injured in a car accident.

zh: 希望我周一前能回去上班。
en: {Hopefully}, I'll be back at work by Monday.

zh: 伤口愈合得很好。
en: The wound is healing {nicely|well}.

zh: 因为咳嗽，我昨晚几乎没怎么睡。
en: I {barely|hardly} slept last night because of my cough.

zh: 你绝对应该去检查一下那颗痣。
en: You should {definitely|certainly|really} get that mole checked.

zh: 别担心，这个止痛药见效很快。
en: Don't worry, this painkiller works {fast|quickly}.

zh: 您的检查结果正常。因此，不需要进一步治疗。
en: Your test results were normal. {Therefore|So|Thus}, no further treatment is needed.

zh: 我身体总体上挺健康的，不过春天会得花粉症。
en: I'm {generally|usually|normally|mostly} healthy, but I do get hay fever in spring.

zh: 我的膝盖疼，尤其是爬楼梯的时候。
en: My knee hurts, {especially|particularly} when I climb stairs.
